fixtureKind: Fictional source-derived examples, not captured sessions. IDs, transcripts, SDP, voice and domains are illustrative; no credentials or usable media.

sources.proves: Native OpenAI-Alpha: quicksilver=v2 header. Internal v3 conversation selector is not a public version request field.

Native started/updated, item.text transcripts, turn.role/transcript and delegation item.id/type/target/content. Parser does not read transcript times or delegation offset. Bounded public raw-source fetch performed for this seed.
Native delegation example carries offset_ms=1000, but assertion checks concatenated delegation content only. Input item ID and user turn example. No transcript time/cutoff association is tested.
Started/updated session.id and native error message variants; errors deliberately mapped to a safe enum instead of copying private text.
Client delegation; audio.output.voice; session/delegation context append with input_text content; 500-byte UTF-8 boundary-preserving chunks.
Native commentary/speakable channels and delegation_item_id, not public delegation_id.
Core v8.0.63 create handler, JSON bootstrap; lines 387-455 retain call identity and media-relay SDP response. This source is not proof of deployed Broker state.
Native /live/<call_id> sideband path, call ID grammar and Location identity extraction. Location is never a request destination here.
POST /v1/live, GET /v1/live/:call_id and POST /v1/realtime/calls/:call_id/hangup routes. POST hangup method is frozen; no response-body codec is assumed.

unproven: No native end-to-end delegation frame capture; no trustworthy transcript time domain, cutoff association, reorder rules or original-user command selection. Normalized delegation always has association=unsupported-native-cutoff and MUST NOT execute. Delegation content is only a hint, not canonical task text.

Native transcript timestamps are not inferred from current public session.* delta events. Native turn.done is not itself delegation authority. Unknown public dialect events cannot be treated as native equivalents.
Closed is synthesized by transport; session.closed is not claimed as an evidenced native event. Output item IDs are optional because parser requires only item.text.
201 transport, requested alias, sideband and hangup success from user handoff do not prove audible duplex, effective model, supported voice, final transcript accuracy or general entitlement.

No retry classifier is implemented in this seed. A 90-second wait is policy, not a Broker guarantee. Two creates within 180 seconds maximum; only definitive no-session allowlisted refresh errors may qualify later, never arbitrary 503/auth/quota errors or ambiguous POST loss.
